name: metric-list
title: Metric List
description: A compact table of entities and their figures for the preview inside a card: a leading avatar or thumbnail, a name with an optional sublabel, and one or more figure columns. Uses namespace exports: MetricList.Root, Header, Column, Body, Row, Entity, Value.

docs.lead: The small table a card shows as a preview: who or what, and the figures beside it. A real table, so each column's width is written once on its header and every row follows it.
docs.usage:
import * as MetricList from "@/components/ui/metric-list"

<MetricList.Root>
  <MetricList.Header>
    <MetricList.Column>Name</MetricList.Column>
    <MetricList.Column className="w-[120px]">Last activity</MetricList.Column>
  </MetricList.Header>
  <MetricList.Body>
    <MetricList.Row>
      <MetricList.Entity media={<Avatar.Root size="32" />} label="Person one" sublabel="Company one" />
      <MetricList.Value>5d ago</MetricList.Value>
    </MetricList.Row>
  </MetricList.Body>
</MetricList.Root>

examples.title: Default
examples.description: A 32px avatar, a name with its sublabel, and one figure column. Values are passed already formatted, so a relative date or a fallback reads like any other figure.
examples.code:
<MetricList.Row>
  <MetricList.Entity
    media={<Avatar.Root size="32" color="gray" placeholderType="user" />}
    label="Person one"
    sublabel="Company one"
  />
  <MetricList.Value>No app activity</MetricList.Value>
</MetricList.Row>

examples.title: Two figures
examples.description: Add a Column and a Value per figure. The width on the Column is a minimum for the cells under it, so the header and the rows cannot drift apart and a long value still fits on one line.

examples.title: Compact
examples.description: size="sm" for rows that are one line, such as a thumbnail and a title. Leave out sublabel and the row keeps a single line.
examples.code:
<MetricList.Root size="sm">
  …
  <MetricList.Entity
    media={<span className="bg-bg-weak-50 h-5 w-9 shrink-0 rounded" />}
    label="Session one"
  />
</MetricList.Root>

api.name: MetricList.Root
api.description: The table. Fills its container's width and spaces its rows; it does not scroll, so cap the rows you pass.

props.name: size
props.description: 'md' for rows carrying an avatar and a sublabel, 'sm' for single-line rows

api.name: MetricList.Header
api.description: The row of column labels. No rule and no band, as the design draws it. Renders its children as one row.

api.name: MetricList.Column
api.description: One column's label. The first column takes the slack; the rest align to the end. A width set with className is a minimum — the column grows if a value needs more, and the first column gives up the difference.

api.name: MetricList.Row
api.description: One row. Give it one Entity and a Value per figure column.

api.name: MetricList.Entity
api.description: The first cell: what the row is about. The label truncates and keeps its full text in title.

props.name: media
props.description: The leading slot: an Avatar on a person, a thumbnail on a thing

props.name: label
props.description: The name of the person or thing

props.name: sublabel
props.description: Under the label, in the quieter colour. Leave it out and the row is one line

api.name: MetricList.Value
api.description: One figure, aligned to the end with tabular digits. Pass it already formatted — a count, a duration, a percentage or a fallback all read the same.
